mandatoryQuestions: What assumptions are being presented as laws without proof?
What information is lost at each representation boundary, and can it be reconstructed?
What must remain outside the coprocessor because it belongs to higher authority/security/privacy/tools/conversation state?
What failure modes appear only under concurrency/interruption/loss/echo/reconnect/thermal pressure/long sessions?
What capability should be learned/reused next time?
What simpler architecture can meet the same acceptance criteria?
What experiment would falsify the proposed advantage?
coreFinding: Agnosticism requires capability negotiation and stable external contracts, not forced reduction of every backend to text nor assumed cross-model latent invariance.

repairedArchitecture.universalVoiceBus: typed capability-negotiated event protocol with timestamps, epochs, provenance and authority metadata

claimVerdicts.claim: unit hypersphere normalization preserves semantics across arbitrary models
claimVerdicts.repair: Use a shared semantic encoder or calibrated cross-model alignment/anchors; unit norm only normalizes magnitude.

claimVerdicts.claim: all modern LLMs expose categorical probability vectors
claimVerdicts.repair: Treat logprobs/probabilities as optional capability; text/event deltas are minimum portable surface.

claimVerdicts.claim: token Hermite spline creates universal semantic trajectory sufficient for speech
claimVerdicts.repair: Spline can smooth timing/conditioning but does not recover lost acoustic/prosodic information.

claimVerdicts.claim: OT straight path guarantees one tensor contraction / 12-18ms universal synthesis
claimVerdicts.repair: Benchmark quality vs NFE and hardware; learned field and decoder determine actual cost/accuracy.

claimVerdicts.claim: 1-cos^2 mic/speaker spectrum robustly separates echo vs human
claimVerdicts.repair: Use AEC residual plus delay-aware coherence/cross-correlation/neural near-end evidence and calibrated double-talk detector.
Application queue clear is not device/WebRTC/ALSA/CoreAudio buffer flush and complexity/latency is implementation-dependent.

claimVerdicts.claim: abort upstream LLM socket is universal
claimVerdicts.repair: Use provider adapter cancellation contract plus epoch invalidation; some APIs cannot instantly stop already-emitted work.
Define portable core contracts plus platform adapters; iOS, Android, browser, native desktop and server have different audio/runtime/permission constraints.

claimVerdicts.claim: ASC should always receive only text tokens
claimVerdicts.repair: Minimum text path plus optional richer native media/semantic representations negotiated by capability.

notDiscovered: prosody source when upstream is text-only

promotion: Create ASC as interface/skill architecture; keep hypersphere/OT-CFM/spectral-curvature kernels in Formula Factory until qualified.
